Jupyter Blog archive — site previews

The same archive of blog.jupyter.org, rendered by four static site generators on identical content (same posts, page URLs, and link rewriting), to compare before choosing one.

  • Hugopreferred

    Card-grid theme, Pagefind full-text search, optimized images, redirect stubs, per-tag/author feeds.

  • Pelicanpreferred

    The same card theme and feature set as the Hugo site, built by Pelican.

  • Zola

    Simpler list theme with Zola's built-in search index; taxonomy pages, feeds, and redirect stubs.

  • MyST

    MyST (mystmd) book-style site with built-in search; the simplest alternate.

Regenerated from the archive's raw/ sources by the preview workflow using medium-archive.
